name: Casio Loopy
description: A 1995 console from Casio released only in Japan and aimed at girls. It had a built-in colour thermal printer that turned game screens into stickers, making it a sticker-making toy as much as a games machine.
curiosities: Its printer used special sticker paper to print in colour.
The Magical Shop accessory captured images from a VCR so users could add text and print them as stickers.
It was never sold outside Japan.
